_comment: Hand-maintained offer catalog, imported by the 'Import catalog from file' button
in /admin. Built from the olmem-tech repo: lib/site-content.ts (pricingPlans,
chatbotOption, workflowCmsOptions, subscriptionPlans) and the PACKAGES map in
app/api/stripe/checkout/route.ts, which hold the authoritative names and amounts.
Importing this costs nothing - no crawl, no LLM call. Edit it here when the site's
offers change, then click Import again. Every claim in allowed_claims must be
verifiable on the page listed in evidence_urls; the drafting step may not exceed them.
search_queries are the discovery seeds. Each is combined as
'{query} {region} business' for every region in DISCOVERY_REGIONS, deduped, then
truncated to max(10, MAX_DISCOVERIES_PER_RUN * 2). At 4 offers x 3 queries x 4
regions = 48 candidates against a cap of 40, so the last offer is partly cut off.
Raise MAX_DISCOVERIES_PER_RUN to 25 for full coverage.

offers.name: Contractor Website Build
offers.summary: Flat-rate contractor website builds from $1,500 to $5,000. Mobile-first and conversion-focused, with a CMS and admin dashboard, an AI chatbot, and the first year of hosting included.
problems_solved: The business has no website, only a social media page or a directory listing
The existing site is not mobile friendly
There is no quote request form, so enquiries only arrive by phone
Service and location pages are missing, so the site does not surface in local search
The owner cannot edit their own content without calling a developer
ideal_customer_signals: Licensed trade contractor serving a defined local service area
Website with no quote form or contact form
Site content or copyright date that has not been updated in several years
A Facebook page listed as the business website
Single-page site with no individual service pages
exclusion_signals: Site is already modern, mobile friendly, and has a clear quote funnel
National franchise whose website is managed corporately
The business is itself a web design or marketing agency
Site displays a recent redesign or launch announcement
allowed_claims: The Starter Contractor Website is $1,500 flat rate and covers up to 5 pages
The Growth Contractor Website is $3,500 flat rate and typically covers 8-12 pages
The Premium Contractor Website is $5,000 flat rate and covers up to 20 conversion-focused pages
Hosting is free for the first year, then $35 per month
A content management system and admin dashboard are included
An AI chatbot is included with every website package
Optional maintenance is $100 per month
offers.call_to_action: Offer to send a short outline of what a lead-ready site would cover for their specific trade and service area.

offers.name: Smart Chat Bot
offers.summary: A $500 one-time AI chatbot trained on the business's own services and FAQs, which answers common questions and captures leads around the clock on a website they already have.
problems_solved: Visitors ask the same questions and nobody answers outside business hours
Enquiries arrive only through a contact form that goes unanswered until the next day
Visitors leave without being qualified or captured as a lead
Staff spend time answering identical questions by phone
ideal_customer_signals: An existing website with no live chat or automated lead capture
A published FAQ page indicating high repeat question volume
Contact page that lists only a phone number and business hours
exclusion_signals: A live chat or chatbot widget is already present on the site
The business sells chatbot or conversational AI services itself
No website exists to install it on
allowed_claims: The Smart Chat Bot is $500 one-time for a site the business already has
It provides 24/7 lead capture and FAQ responses
It is trained on the business's own services and FAQs
Website integration is included
It is included at no extra cost with every Olmem Tech website package
offers.call_to_action: Offer to show the questions a chatbot would field on their site in its first week.

offers.name: Workflow Automation
offers.summary: Automation of lead routing, notifications, follow-up sequences, and tool integrations. A $99 planning deposit secures the setup and covers the initial planning session, with final scope quoted after review.
problems_solved: Leads are routed and followed up by hand, so some are missed
The same information is retyped between a website, a spreadsheet, and a CRM
No automatic follow-up happens after an enquiry arrives
Notifications depend on someone remembering to check an inbox
ideal_customer_signals: Enquiry process described on the site as call or email only
Multiple disconnected tools referenced across the site
Quote or booking process that states a manual turnaround time
Business coordinating scheduling, dispatch, or supplier orders
exclusion_signals: The business already advertises automated workflows or an integrated platform
The business sells automation or systems integration services itself
Too small to have a repeatable process worth automating
allowed_claims: A $99 planning deposit secures the setup and covers the initial planning session
Final pricing is determined after reviewing the specific needs and systems
Most projects range from $500 to several thousand depending on complexity and integrations
Lead routing, notifications, follow-up sequences, and CRM or tool integrations are covered
offers.call_to_action: Offer a short planning call to map their current process before quoting anything.

offers.name: CMS and Integrations
offers.summary: A custom content management system with supplier and API integrations, including catalog, fitment, or product data sync. A $99 planning deposit covers the initial planning session, with final scope quoted after review.
problems_solved: Staff cannot update site content without a developer
Product, catalog, or inventory data is maintained by hand in more than one place
Supplier data is not reflected on the website
Customers must call to check availability because the site cannot show it
ideal_customer_signals: Product or parts catalog on the site with no search or filtering
Pages that instruct customers to call for availability or pricing
Visible signs of a static site with stale inventory or listings
A distributor or dealer carrying supplier-sourced product data
exclusion_signals: The site already runs on a modern CMS the staff clearly maintain
The business sells CMS or integration services itself
No product or content catalog to manage
allowed_claims: A $99 planning deposit secures the setup and covers the initial planning session
Final pricing is determined after reviewing the specific needs and systems
Most projects range from $500 to several thousand depending on complexity and integrations
A custom content management system, supplier and API integrations, and fitment, catalog, or product data sync are covered
offers.call_to_action: Offer to review how their catalog or content is maintained today and where a sync would remove duplicate work.
